rationale.conceptual: The method uses standard DFT with a standard functional (GGA-PBEsol) and the well-known quasi-harmonic Debye model for thermal properties. No novel algorithms or deep domain theory is required; the challenge is routine application of established protocols.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves setting up crystal structures, running DFT for multiple volumes, fitting an equation of state, and post-processing with a Debye model. This requires 4-5 sequential stages with dependencies, including the use of an external DFT code (setup and convergence management), which adds moderate orchestration complexity.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires standard DFT calculations (GGA-PBEsol) and quasi-harmonic Debye model fitting, all well-established methods. The pipeline involves a few steps with some tooling but no complex orchestration. Overall difficulty is moderate-low conceptually and moderate in execution.

compute_estimate.reasoning: The simulation cells contain only 5 atoms; plane-wave or all-electron DFT at the GGA level is light and CPU-only. Memory needs are modest; no external datasets are required beyond trivial crystal structures.
